assets.label: Toronto skyline waterfront hero illustration
assets.role: 16:10 hero background illustration, skyline and waterfront only
assets.rationale: The skyline, CN Tower, waterfront reflections, trees, boats, and engraved texture are complex raster illustration material and should be generated as a standalone image asset.

generation.prompt: Generate a production-ready standalone 16:10 transparent WebP source asset of the Toronto skyline from the waterfront, matching the reference's black-and-white engraved stipple/etching illustration style. Include the CN Tower centered, downtown buildings, Rogers Centre dome, tree line, calm Lake Ontario waterfront, reflections, and the two small sailboats as part of the city/water scene. Remove all website UI, brand marks, buttons, typography, metrics, avatars, hearts, navigation, page chrome, and neighboring contamination. Do not include any clouds; clouds will be separate layer assets. Keep generous transparent sky area above the tower and transparent margin around the full waterfront composition. Output should feel like a refined editorial financial-services hero illustration, crisp black ink on transparency, no color except subtle grayscale ink.
